_comment: FULL FEDERATED REPORT SCENARIO (G5S6R4, everything on). Architecture: multiAsset.mode='fast' -> 6 INDEPENDENT single-asset EKFs + SwarmRelativeSolver as a read-only relative layer. Ground stack: code + carrier + Doppler + ground-space TWSTFT to all 5 towers, realism grade, realistic atmosphere, luni-solar + SRP. Relative layer: BOTH the ISL two-way RANGE (shape) and the ISL two-way TIME TRANSFER (relative clocks). NOTE the clock layer required a 2-line fix in SwarmRelativeSolver.solve: its gate read only multiAsset.twoWayTimeTransferISL.enable, which validateMasterConfig:legacySatelliteTimeTransfer hard-blocks, so the layer was UNREACHABLE. The gate now also accepts the sanctioned key measurements.isl.twoWay.timeTransfer.enable. Only .enable/.useInEKF are blocked; the .sigma_m/.delayCal.* noise parameters the solver reads are not, so they stay under multiAsset.twoWayTimeTransferISL. ISL range error is the run11 MATCHED structure (2 cm thermal + 28 cm constant per-link delay-cal bias), i.e. today's uncalibrated hardware, not an optimistic assumption. STEP 2: multiAsset.twoWayISL.lightTime.enable=true -- the synthetic range now carries the finite two-way propagation delay (SwarmRelativeSolver.twoWayLightTime_) instead of an instantaneous |r_i-r_k|. STEP 3: the relative-CLOCK layer now uses the REAL four-timestamp physics (InterSatelliteFourTimestampTimeTransferBuilder chain) instead of a synthetic clock difference; see measurements.isl.twoWay.fourTimestampPhysical.* Duration reduced to 1800 s. The ISL two-way schedule keeps stop_s=3600, which simply means it never reaches its stop inside the arc -- no behavioural change. ISL DELAY CALIBRATION set from an ISL hardware argument, no longer inherited from run1: constant 0.05 m (0.33 ns) is the post-calibration residual for a crosslink terminal built and calibrated end-to-end by one team, NOT the ~1.9 ns typical of a BIPM ground station calibrated by a travelling reference; drift 0.01 m is thermal variation over an orbit, the part no ground calibration removes. These touch ONLY the ISL range (multiAsset.twoWayISL.delayCal -> SwarmRelativeSolver.islNoise_ -> pairBias -> the ISL range row). The ISL clock (multiAsset.twoWayTimeTransferISL) and the ground TWSTFT (measurements.twoWayTimeTransfer) are separate keys read by separate builders and are unchanged.
